create_unified_radial_mlp: create a UnifiedRadialMLP from a list of RadialMLP modules using the factory function
build_UnifiedRadialMLP: build a UnifiedRadialMLP module that batches the first linear layer across multiple RadialMLPs
run_UnifiedRadialMLP_forward: run the UnifiedRadialMLP forward pass to compute all radial outputs in a single batched operation
test_validate_radial_mlp: test the _validate_radial_mlp function to check a RadialMLP has the expected 7-layer structure
refactor_UnifiedRadialMLP_umas_radial_ml: refactor the UnifiedRadialMLP umas_radial_mlp method to apply layers 2+ with layer norm and SiLU activations
